content: Bǝla Magii kǝ yaa Israila
Aiciya, ǝn naagan am sǝran zaraabah taakiya, daadijahamiyam baɗǝm daral mizhangyil kǝ akumba tǝ ɗuula dagalla, baɗǝmmatǝra daral bama taataka yuwa haiya.
Ɓagavtǝra bama akumba ard yuwa haiy tsuufǝg kǝ iitǝr baɗǝm kǝ gata adzahadzaha musa.
Baɗǝmmatǝra zaruuzǝg kǝ dǝgzǝgi sahi ma ghǝrazhigǝla,
baɗǝmmaatǝra hǝɓaruuhǝɓǝg kǝ yu kwa vǝlatǝr Daadamazhigǝl aɗaba hǝɓaruu yu ma akura kwa maratǝrda Daadamazhigǝla, kwa da dagal ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝra, Kwahiin kǝ akura iin Kǝristi.
Bakǝvakwaha cinngu bi Daadamazhigǝl kǝ ǝmtakǝr dǝ kyalmaatǝr biya, ruwararuug ma tǝghala.
Nalnǝg wan kǝ dǝga garav kǝskimyam ndakwana haik kǝ kǝma dǝgaha kǝlaadǝr bandkwa ɓag nǝ iitǝra.

Namal bi kǝ lii ɓargarnǝs kwatǝnahǝr kǝ ghǝllah band kwa naral kyalmah biya. Aɗaba vindavinda ma kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl taakiya, “cahwararacahwarǝg nǝ uudaha ar zǝgaana ar hǝɓgaana, baz shakalga ard ɓa gwaragwara.”
Ɓagiyam bi kǝ gwaragwar bandkwa ɓag kyalmah biya, aɗaba ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝg nǝ uudah alfu kulbu tar uufaɗa ba daaval palla.
Fǝshiyam bi kǝ Yaazhigǝl bandkwa ɓagar kyalmah biya, ghwahatǝraghwahǝg ghavalaha ruwararuuga.
Zaviyam bi kǝ ghai bandkwa ɓag kyalmah biya, aɗaba ciɓatǝraciɓǝg nǝ zarha ɓǝlga Daadamazhigǝla.
Kwanahaan kǝ dǝgitah dzǝghaar dǝ iitǝrǝn ba garava, vindavavindǝg wan mbakyarvad ɓǝlkiyama nǝ uud kǝ magiya, kǝmiyamǝn tlakiyama nǝ ghyǝnga zamanna.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, akwama agha tlatla taaikya ghacighaghacig ba danngala, aiciya, fafǝg kǝ hǝnkala mbǝɗa biya.

Maay fǝshǝgi tlakuratlǝg kwa tapǝghana bi kǝ dzǝgaardzǝg dǝ uudah biya. Aɗaba Daadamazhigǝla uuda jiirjiir nǝ iina da ɗukurǝs bi am dǝm damma fǝshig kwa juujig kǝ ndzǝɗaru biya, akwama damǝmdǝg fǝshiga, da wurkurantwurg kǝ ɗuula ngǝdlǝg kwam da dzugwantdzug nǝ uurama.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, kuramǝn ǝn waikur naiyna, kuvamkuvǝg kǝ ɓagar kwatǝnahǝr kǝ ghǝllaha.
Ən tagkur kǝskuramǝm am ɗainaɗaig kǝ ghǝr na, dzamamdzamǝg kǝ ghǝr ghǝravaru tǝghǝr kǝ dǝgiti ǝn tagkur naiya.

Kuuwǝn dǝga barka nǝ iin kwa kiyam taa uus dǝvakiya, mbats iin bi wa fǝkiyama ndzǝga pal ma avǝza Kǝristi biya? Bruudyin kiyam ghwadǝg nǝ miyamǝna, iin bi wa fǝkiyama ndzǝga pal ma vǝgha Kǝristi biya?
Ba pall tsaw bruudina, mbats kǝmiyamǝn kiyam ɗyakna ba vǝgh palla, aɗaba baɗǝmma miyama ba bruudi pall wa kiyam zǝg nǝ miyama.
Zharamzharg kǝ uudaha israila. Mbats lii zaa dǝga kyuulǝga, ar ba dǝgit pal bi nǝ iitǝr ma zaa dǝga kyuulǝg kwa vǝlǝva kǝ Daadamazhigǝl tǝ alaga kyuulǝg biya?
Awan tlatlǝg nai vakwani? Dǝgiti aa hǝrvaru kǝ ghǝli ci nǝ dǝgita? Nii ghǝlini ka ci nǝ dǝgiti?
Əndkwah biya, ǝn tlatla taakiya, dǝga kyuulǝgi kwa vǝlǝgar lii ɓagar kwatǝnah kǝ ghǝlla, ar vǝlgar kǝ shatanaha, kǝ Daadamazhigǝl biya. Ən naiy am nal band shatanah biya.
Ɓaga bi taakiya am hǝɓu ma kuwa Yaazhigǝla, dlaɓa am hǝɓu ma dǝga shatanah biya. Ɓaga bi taakiya am zuu kǝ dǝga Yaazhigǝla, dlaɓa am zuu kǝ dǝga shatanah biya.
Kiyam pǝcca ghaiya Yaazhigǝl kiyava ɓa shilǝg nii? Jiyamujig kǝ iin dǝ ndzǝɗ hi?
Ɓag kǝ dǝgita kwakyarvad fǝvaran Daadamazhigǝla
“Haiyakiyamanthaig nǝ uud kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝmma” Ɗǝm bi dǝgitah mǝng tlǝran biya, “Baɗǝm dǝgitah haiyakimathaig nǝ uuda,” Ɗǝm bi dǝgitahi da fǝgara ndzǝɗ ma fadǝghǝr kǝ uud biya.
Ɓagar bi kǝ dǝgit maraw ghǝragh kalti biya, ɓagarɓag baz zǝraabagha.
Zamzǝg kǝ hulfa dǝgiti valav vaka valla tlu baɗǝmma, ba kwal ndavǝgaan kǝskurama, haik dzamgaan kǝskuram ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaru kǝ vakavaki aa sǝgal dǝ tluwiina.
Aɗaba tagatag nǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla taakiya, “Duuniya ard dǝgiti ma vakaita baɗǝmma dǝga Daadamazhigǝla,”

Akwama ɗahakurǝtɗahǝg daddakwa maay gatǝg da za kaffa, ma haiyamanthaig kǝ dagauwa, zamzǝg baɗǝm kǝ hulfa dǝgitahi aa vǝlkur nǝ iina, ba kwal ndavǝga, haik dzamgaan kǝskuram ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaru kǝ vakavaki aa sǝgal dǝ dǝgzǝgiina.
Akwama tagakuuratag nǝ uud taakiya, “Aa hǝrvara kǝ ghǝll wanǝnna,” zambiya, mbakyarvad dadda kwa tagkurataga, dlaɓa hǝna nǝ ǝrviɗmahuɗaruwa.
Ən tlatla dǝgiti da dzamǝg nǝ uuda nǝ iin ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, dǝgaru biya. Tagdatag pallaru taakiya “Aujilbǝg kǝ dzamaghǝra uudan da tsǝkwava kǝ kwara ghǝrari?
Akwama taganaratag kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla lakwti ǝn da zaa dǝgzǝga, aujibǝg da ghudgus ǝlbǝg nǝ uud tǝghǝr kǝ dǝgiti naa zǝg naiy tambar taganaratag kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhǝgǝli?”
Aiciya, baɗǝm dǝgiti am ɓag nǝ uurama, aanji am zǝg dǝ zǝga, bi am hǝɓǝg dǝ hǝɓǝga, ɓagamɓag mbakyarvad ndanngǝra Daadamazhigǝla.
Namal bi kǝ ɗuula ɓa haip kǝ yahudah biya, aanji ma lii ar yahudah biya, bii lii gata Daadamazhigǝl biya.

Ɓagamɓag band kwa ǝn ɓag naiya. Ən ɓa kǝla ndzǝɗar maa cinngu aanji ba war kǝ ǝmtakǝra dǝgitahi ǝn ɓag nai baɗǝmma, kwakyarvad ghǝrar pal wan ɓag nai biya, ǝn ɓag kwakyarvad mǝlgaru kǝ uudah ba ɗyakka, aɗaba ar tlǝkǝna kǝ katǝga.
